theme: Soft Utility mixed with Swiss High-Contrast. Light mode priority for high visibility in retail environments.

headings.rules: Tight tracking (tracking-tight). Use text-2xl to text-4xl for dashboard section headers. Never center-align unless explicitly needed for balance.

body.rules: Crisp and legible. Use text-slate-600 for secondary information.

mono.rules: Use exclusively for measurements (e.g., 2000x1000mm), SKU codes, and price values to give a precise, technical feel.

visual enhancers.shadows: Soft, ambient shadows for floating cards (shadow-lg shadow-slate-200/50).
visual enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) for structural elements, 2px for active focus states.
visual enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for main note cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for category pills and badges.

component name.NoteCard: Card layout: Client Name (bold) + Phone (subtle text-sm). Top-right category badge. A dedicated 'technical specs' block using monospace for 'medidas' (measurements). Include an 'Anexos' icon and a 'Pedir Preços' CTA.
component name.BottomNav: Fixed bottom navigation for mobile with glassmorphism background. 4 tabs: Início, Clientes, Fornecedores, Tarefas.
component name.FloatingActionButton: Bottom-right, highly visible dark slate color, triggers a 'Nova Nota' modal. Must be slightly lifted with shadow.
component name.SupplierQuoteCompare: Bento-grid module. Displays supplier prices side-by-side. The lowest price should be automatically highlighted with a subtle green border and a 'Melhor Preço' label.
component name.QuoteRequestModal: Slide-over or modal UI allowing the manager to select a supplier, preview an auto-generated email template requesting a quote for specific 'medidas', and an 'Enviar Email' button.
component name.SectionFilter: Horizontal scrolling list of pill buttons to filter the dashboard by Construção, Bricolagem, Decoração, and Jardim.

grids.dashboard: Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). High density for data correlation. Wide gaps (gap-6) for breathing room.

layouts.overall: Mobile-first, optimized for thumb reach on the store floor. 'One cognitive decision per screen'.
layouts.desktop: Sidebar navigation instead of bottom nav. Split pane: notes list on the left, active note/quote comparison on the right.

motion.interactions: Translate-y-1 on hover for interactive cards. Scale 0.98 on active (click).
motion.transitions: Smooth layout animations when filtering categories (using framer-motion layout prop).
motion.micro: Pulse animation for pending actions or newly received quotes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on category badges is APCA compliant.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., 'data-testid="filter-jardim"').

media: Use lucide-react icons for visual context (e.g., Hammer, Paintbrush, Flower, Sofa).
3d libraries: Not required for this utility dashboard.

image urls.description: Concrete building construction image for the Construção section background or empty state.
Plants nursery image for the Jardim section background or empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive React application using Tailwind CSS. Focus on the Bricomarché manager's workflow. Ensure the 'Supplier Quote Compare' and 'Quote Request' interfaces are fully mocked and robust. Use lucide-react for icons. Do not use placeholders for missing functionalities; mock the UI effectively. Ensure language is European Portuguese (pt-PT). IMPORTANT: You have .js files not .tsx files, so write standard React JSX in .js files. Use Framer Motion for list filtering animations. Integrate sonner for toasts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Do not apply universal transitions (`transition: all`).
Do not center align the app container.
Never use emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
